page_title: BOU 1-1 NOT | Bournemouth v Nottingham Forest 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Rebecca Welch is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+7' The attendance is 11200.
90+5' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Neto.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Callum Hudson-Odoi as he is replaced by Rodrigo Ribeiro (Nottingham).
86' The main referee, Rebecca Welch, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Neto (Bournemouth) is given a yellow card for dissent.
86' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
84' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch for Lloyd Kelly.
82' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' One of the players from Nottingham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
81' Rebecca Welch blows the whistle, Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul.
78' Here is a change. Neco Williams is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham).
78' Substitution. Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) on for Anthony Elanga.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
74' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Nottingham).
73' Rebecca Welch shows the yellow card to Ryan Yates (Nottingham) for a heavy challenge.
73' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Danilo (Nottingham) replaces Nicolas Dominguez.
71' Substitution. Luis Sinisterra makes his way off the pitch and Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) comes on as his replacement.
70' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
65' A dangerous looking corner kick from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
62' Nuno Espirito Santo is stunned as referee Rebecca Welch shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
62' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Rebecca Welch blows his whistle for a foul.
58' The referee blows his whistle as Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
56' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Ryan Christie and he is replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
56' It is time for a substitution. Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is on for Justin Kluivert.
55' A yellow card is awarded to Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham).
55' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Rebecca Welch blows for a foul.
53' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

52' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
51' Nottingham concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Bournemouth win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

48' What a poor attempt! Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
47' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
46' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nottingham.
46' Andoni Iraola makes a half-time substitution. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) comes on in place of Antoine Semenyo.
46' The whistle blows and Rebecca Welch starts the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 1 Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
45' Nottingham are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
45' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
40' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
39' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
35' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
32' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
30' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
29' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.

28' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Nottingham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots low towards goal, but Neto makes a magnificent save!
23' A yellow-coloured card is received by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth).
22' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' The resulting corner from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is cleared.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
18' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Bournemouth earn a corner.
17' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
16' A player from Bournemouth takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.

11' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Neto pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
8' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
5' 1 - 0 GOAL - 1:0! The corner comes over and Luis Sinisterra flicks on with his head to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
5' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
3' Bournemouth work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
3' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Rebecca Welch is introduced as the referee for today's match.
